answer.answer: The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) relies on Member Lending Institutions to extend assistance to non-corporate micro-enterprises [E01]. The scheme provides financial assistance extended by Member Lending Institutions to the non-corporate, non-farm sector income generating activities of micro and small entities [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana relies on Member Lending Institutions to extend assistance to non-corporate micro-enterprises
